input.quote: Sparkling shall pay the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the Fee Schedule.
input.rationale: Fees are fixed by reference to Schedule "A" and there is no pricing-parity or most-favoured-nation language anywhere in the Agreement, so no MFN obligation burdens us. No redline needed (we would welcome an MFN in our favour if offered).

input.quote: both parties agree not to hire or allow its respective affiliates to hire any employee of the other party, or any person who was an employee of the other party during the previous six months and who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement
input.rationale: Section 19 is a mutual no-hire (not merely a non-solicit), extends to any employee of the other party rather than personnel engaged on this Agreement, binds affiliates, and has no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out; it also survives under Section 18. We narrowed it to our fallback: a non-solicit of personnel actually involved in the services, with the standard carve-outs and no hiring ban.

input.quote: (b) Sparkling may terminate this Agreement at any time upon ninety (90) calendar days written notice to Garman.
input.rationale: We do have a convenience right and Garman has none (good), but the notice period is 90 days (our position is 30) and there is no pro-rata refund of prepaid licence or maintenance fees on exit. We shortened the notice to 30 days and added the refund; 60–90 days with a refund is our fallback if Garman pushes back.

input.quote: For a renewable one-year term commencing upon the Maintenance Commencement Date, subject to payment of maintenance fees in accordance with the Fee Schedule but without additional fees or charges, Garman shall provide the following Maintenance Services:
input.rationale: The maintenance term is only described as "renewable", with no stated renewal mechanics, non-renewal notice window or limit on renewal pricing, while the licence continues perpetually so long as fees are paid. We set express 12-month renewals with a 30-day non-renewal right and capped any renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and 3% (5% is our fallback).
